recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future terminology changes for Procedure.code should be handled by a new Patient Care tracker rather than by re-opening this already-applied DSTU1 value-set request.
issue_request: FHIR-3716 was a Published Patient Care change request for DSTU1 asking to specify a value set for the type of Procedure. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution said Procedure is broad, so an example binding was appropriate, with SNOMED CT or other systems as examples and examples showing the breadth of Procedure.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the issue was applied in svn revision 4812. In the imported Git history, db3447c54e826ae79f4543ff50d2134eb544d8a1 (#3716 - Procedure.type valueset) added a ProcedureType example binding and introduced a SNOMED CT procedure type value set.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. The old Procedure.type element was renamed to Procedure.code in 77c0aa01f08d8517bcba177c89b296095491221d, and the current binding points to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/procedure-code. That value set is Procedure Codes (SNOMED CT), defined as descendants of SNOMED CT 71388002 Procedure. Current examples and narrative cover a broad Procedure scope, including clinical, therapy, education, HCBS, narrative-only, obstetric, device, and ventilator-setting cases. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already contains the requested example binding, the corresponding SNOMED CT procedure-code value set, and examples that address the breadth concern.
